text: Okay, like I literally just told you. I don't want to keep the speaker. And I don't want to cancel the whole order. That's not what I asked. I just want the blue one with 20 hours battery life and water resistance. Is that really the only one? Can you check again? I don't believe that's true.
zh: 好的，就像我刚才明确告诉你的。我不想保持音箱。我也不想取消整个订单。那不是我问的。我只需要那个蓝色、电池续航20小时、防水的。那真的是唯一一个吗？你能再检查一下吗？我不相信那是真的。
